summary.text: Andrew Pruski is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 33A, in Anne Arundel County, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former teacher and school board president, he has served in the House since January 2023 and sits on the Economic Matters Committee.

paragraphs.text: Pruski was born in Batavia, New York, and earned a B.A. in history in 2000 and an M.S. in secondary education in 2001 from Niagara University.

He taught social studies at Frederick Douglass High School in Prince George's County from 2001 to 2005, was a supervisor of assessment for Baltimore County Public Schools from 2005 to 2014, and has been a supervisor of internal assessment for Prince George's County Public Schools since 2014.

Pruski served on the Anne Arundel County Board of Appeals from 2006 to 2009 and on the county Board of Education from 2009 to 2014, serving as its president in 2012-2013, and was a member of the county Board of Health from 2014 to 2022.
He was elected to the House of Delegates in November 2022 and sits on the Economic Matters Committee and its Economic Development, Land Use and Zoning, and Workers' Compensation subcommittees.
He has chaired the Anne Arundel County House Delegation since 2025.
